keywords: dns resolver unbound cache forward dot tls dnssec blocklist adblock
summary: Unbound is the local DNS resolver. Enable it for a cache, add blocklists for ad blocking, and use DNS-over-TLS for encrypted upstream queries. DNSSEC validates answers but needs correct system time.

keywords: dot dns over tls encrypted dns 853 cloudflare quad9 forward
summary: OPNsense 26.7 supports DNS-over-TLS, not a native DoH type. Add an upstream on port 853 with TLS verification of the provider hostname (for example cloudflare-dns.com).
gui_path: Services > Unbound DNS > DNS over TLS

keywords: firewall rule allow block port lan wan policy
summary: Rules are evaluated top-down; the first match wins. Add a LAN allow rule for the service port and keep the default block rule last.

keywords: nat port forward dstnat incoming rdp web server
summary: A port forward maps an external WAN port to an internal address and port. Remember to add a matching WAN firewall rule allowing that port.

keywords: dhcp kea dnsmasq lease pool range reservation
summary: Enable one DHCP server only. Set a pool inside your LAN subnet and point clients at the firewall as DNS server.

keywords: clamav antivirus virus scan freshclam malware
summary: ClamAV scans files for malware. On small appliances use scheduled scans rather than on-access scanning to save memory and CPU.

keywords: crowdsec intrusion prevention ips bouncer ban attackers
summary: CrowdSec blocks hostile IPs using shared signals. Enable the agent, local API and firewall bouncer together.

keywords: wireguard vpn tunnel peer exit node tailscale
summary: WireGuard needs an instance, a peer with a public key, and an interface assignment. A Tailscale exit node additionally requires approval in the Tailscale admin console.

keywords: interface lan wan ip address subnet gateway vlan nic
summary: Assign WAN to the internet-facing NIC and LAN to the internal NIC. Set a static LAN address such as 192.168.1.1/24 and enable DHCP on LAN.

keywords: backup restore snapshot config rollback undo
summary: Download a configuration backup before major changes. The Security Wizard also saves its own snapshot and can undo the last apply.

keywords: update firmware upgrade repository mirror check for updates
summary: Check for updates before upgrading and read the release notes. An isolated test network cannot reach the package mirror.

keywords: hardware cpu memory ram disk intel nic performance sizing
summary: For 2 GB RAM or less, keep the DNS cache small and skip antivirus scanning. More RAM allows ClamAV and CrowdSec together. Multi-core CPUs help encrypted DNS and VPN throughput.
